label: Outer surface epithelial cell (tonsil surface)
resolved_names: keratinizing squamous epithelial cell of the palatine tonsil surface
tissue_context: palatine tonsil surface (lining) epithelium, continuous with the stratified squamous epithelium of the oral mucosa
evidence: Massoni-Badosa et al. (2024) identified epithelial clusters overlapping the keratinocyte populations of the oral mucosa (one being FDCSP epithelium). Independent human-tonsil literature (Okda et al. 2021; Crowell et al. 2025; Jackson et al. 2023; Sarmiento Varon et al. 2021; Kumar et al. 2006) resolves the tonsil epithelium into two compartments: a surface (lining) stratified squamous, keratinizing epithelium marked by K5/K14, and a reticulated crypt epithelium marked by K8/K18/K19. The Outer surface / surface cluster corresponds to the K5+/K14+ stratified squamous surface (lining) compartment.
